headline: Oil Hits Five-Month High as Global Equities Flounder on Tech Jitters
summary: Crude oil advanced to a five-month high amid escalating Middle East tensions. Simultaneously, global stock benchmarks stumbled on artificial intelligence valuation concerns, while Great Britain retail sales contracted as consumer spending retreated.
why: Crude oil is the world's most traded commodity and a primary input cost across global industry. Sharp energy price rallies risk complicating central bank efforts to ease headline inflation.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East raises supply disruption premiums in global energy markets.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Surging fuel costs squeeze household discretionary budgets, softening consumer spending.

why_moved: Elevated geopolitical conflict in the Middle East drove crude prices to multi-month highs, weighing on global equity sentiment.
